description: This file is a Jupyter Notebook containing source code for a Chatbot project that utilizes LangChain, GPT models, and a database for generating SQL queries based on user input and returning data from the database. It includes code for importing libraries, setting up environment variables, database connection, model initialization, prompt generation, execution of queries, and answer generation using the GEMINI model.

methods.name: generate_prompt
methods.description: Creates a prompt template combining user question and database schema info for SQL query generation.

methods.name: get_query
methods.description: Extracts the SQL query enclosed within ```sql ... ``` from model output text.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Executes a given SQL query against the database and fetches all resulting rows.

methods.name: generate_final_prompt
methods.description: Constructs a comprehensive prompt combining question, SQL, data, and schema info for answer generation.

methods.name: get_text_content
methods.description: Extracts text content from GEMINI model response object, handling different parts and formats.
